issues.label: Subject-matter jurisdiction
issues.why: Court must confirm it has authority over the claims and remedies sought.

issues.label: Personal jurisdiction
issues.why: Court must ensure it has jurisdiction over Yanhui based on contacts/service.

issues.label: Venue propriety
issues.why: Court must confirm Nevada/Las Vegas is the proper forum for the dispute.

issues.label: Service of process validity
issues.why: Proper service affects default, deadlines, and court power over defendant.

issues.label: Pleading sufficiency
issues.why: Complaint must state plausible claims for each asserted cause of action.

issues.label: Statute of limitations
issues.why: Court must determine whether any claims are time-barred.

issues.label: Choice-of-law rules
issues.why: Court must decide what law governs contract/tort/quasi-contract issues.

issues.label: Oral contract enforceability
issues.why: Court must decide whether an unwritten agreement is legally enforceable.

issues.label: Statute of frauds applicability
issues.why: Joint venture involving real property interests/profits may require a writing.

issues.label: Joint venture existence
issues.why: Court must decide whether facts establish a joint venture relationship.

issues.label: Elements of joint venture
issues.why: Court must assess intent, contribution, control, and profit-sharing elements.

issues.label: Fiduciary duties between venturers
issues.why: If joint venture exists, fiduciary duties may expand liability/remedies.

issues.label: Contract formation and terms
issues.why: Court must determine assent, consideration, and the agreement’s essential terms.

issues.label: Contract definiteness
issues.why: Court must decide whether terms (profits, expenses, timing) are sufficiently definite.

issues.label: Breach of contract elements
issues.why: Court must determine breach and causation of claimed losses.

issues.label: Implied covenant viability
issues.why: Court must decide if implied covenant claim is duplicative or independently actionable.

issues.label: Implied covenant breach standard
issues.why: Court must apply the correct test for bad faith frustrating contract benefits.

issues.label: Unjust enrichment availability
issues.why: Court must decide if quasi-contract is barred by an express contract theory.

issues.label: Unjust enrichment elements
issues.why: Court must assess benefit conferred, appreciation, and inequitable retention.

issues.label: Conversion elements
issues.why: Court must decide whether conversion applies to money/proceeds under Nevada law.

issues.label: Conversion of specific funds
issues.why: Money conversion typically requires identifiable, segregated funds or proceeds.

issues.label: Tracing of proceeds
issues.why: Court must determine whether sale/rental proceeds can be traced for recovery.

issues.label: Constructive trust remedy
issues.why: Court must consider equitable remedies for alleged misuse of venture property.

issues.label: Resulting trust theory
issues.why: Payment of purchase money may support a resulting trust in real property.

issues.label: Accounting remedy
issues.why: Joint venture disputes often require an accounting of rents, expenses, and profits.

issues.label: Partition or property interest
issues.why: Court must determine whether plaintiff seeks/has an interest supporting partition-type relief.

issues.label: Measure of contract damages
issues.why: Court must apply correct measure: expectancy, reliance, or restitution as appropriate.

issues.label: Return of investment theory
issues.why: Court must decide if $200,000 is recoverable as loan, capital contribution, or restitution.

issues.label: Profit-sharing calculation
issues.why: Court must define profit (gross vs net) and treatment of expenses and taxes.

issues.label: Offsets and credits
issues.why: Court must consider credits for mortgage payments, repairs, management, and contributions.

issues.label: Mitigation of damages
issues.why: Court must assess whether plaintiff had a duty/opportunity to mitigate losses.

issues.label: Prejudgment interest
issues.why: Court must decide if damages are liquidated to support prejudgment interest.

issues.label: Punitive damages availability
issues.why: Court must determine whether tort claims allow punitive damages and if pled/proven.

issues.label: Attorney fees basis
issues.why: Court must identify any contractual/statutory basis for fees and comply with procedure.

issues.label: Default set-aside propriety
issues.why: Court must ensure default was properly set aside and its effects on disclosures.

issues.label: Discovery closure implications
issues.why: Court must assess whether discovery status affects ability to compute damages.

issues.label: NRCP 16.1 duty to disclose
issues.why: Court must interpret scope and timing of required damages computations.

issues.label: Adequacy of initial disclosures
issues.why: Court must decide whether plaintiff ever served a compliant computation.

issues.label: What qualifies as computation
issues.why: Court must determine if “moving papers” or estimates satisfy NRCP 16.1.

issues.label: Duty to supplement disclosures
issues.why: Court must apply supplementation obligations when damages evolve over time.

issues.label: Special vs general damages
issues.why: Court must correctly classify claimed damages to determine disclosure requirements.

issues.label: Whether damages are straightforward
issues.why: Court must decide if simplicity excuses detail or still requires computation.

issues.label: Expert reliance and timing
issues.why: Court must consider whether needing an expert justifies delay in computation.

issues.label: Motion in limine appropriateness
issues.why: Court must decide if exclusion via in limine is proper enforcement of disclosure rules.

issues.label: NRCP 37(c) sanction framework
issues.why: Court must apply correct rule/standard for exclusion for nondisclosure.

issues.label: Substantial justification
issues.why: Court must decide whether late/non-disclosure was substantially justified.

issues.label: Harmlessness of nondisclosure
issues.why: Court must assess prejudice and ability to cure before imposing exclusion.

issues.label: Proportionality of sanction
issues.why: Court must ensure exclusion/dismissal is proportionate to the violation.

issues.label: Consideration of lesser sanctions
issues.why: Before case-ending sanctions, court must consider alternatives (continuance, fees, limited evidence).

issues.label: Willfulness or bad faith
issues.why: Case-ending sanctions typically require findings on willfulness/culpability.

issues.label: Due process notice and hearing
issues.why: Plaintiff must have notice and opportunity to be heard before dismissal with prejudice.

issues.label: Specific findings requirement
issues.why: Court must make adequate findings supporting exclusion and dismissal under governing law.

issues.label: Calendar call dismissal authority
issues.why: Court must confirm procedural authority to dismiss at calendar call without trial.

issues.label: Conversion of exclusion into dismissal
issues.why: Court must decide whether exclusion logically leaves no triable issues or whether nominal/other relief remains.

issues.label: Nominal damages possibility
issues.why: If breach proven but damages excluded, court must consider nominal damages viability.

issues.label: Equitable relief despite exclusion
issues.why: Court must consider whether equitable remedies (trust/accounting) survive damages exclusion.

issues.label: Claim-by-claim impact of exclusion
issues.why: Court must analyze how damages preclusion affects each cause of action separately.

issues.label: Dismissal with prejudice standard
issues.why: Court must apply correct standard for involuntary dismissal and its finality.

issues.label: NRCP 41(b) considerations
issues.why: Court must consider whether dismissal operates as adjudication on the merits and prerequisites.

issues.label: Issue of claim preclusion
issues.why: With-prejudice dismissal affects future litigation; court must ensure correctness.

issues.label: Reconsideration/late filing effect
issues.why: Court must decide whether to consider the untimely supplemental computation anyway.

issues.label: Excusable neglect for lateness
issues.why: Court must assess whether late compliance could be allowed under excusable neglect standards.

issues.label: Continuance as cure
issues.why: Court must consider whether a short continuance could cure prejudice instead of dismissal.

issues.label: Prejudice to defendant
issues.why: Court must evaluate how late disclosure affects defense preparation and trial fairness.

issues.label: Trial management discretion limits
issues.why: Court must balance docket control with adjudication on the merits under Nevada standards.

issues.label: Evidentiary scope after exclusion
issues.why: Court must define what evidence remains admissible (e.g., existence of agreement vs damages figures).

issues.label: Admissibility of rental/sale records
issues.why: Court must consider foundation, relevance, hearsay exceptions, and business records for damages proofs.

issues.label: Standing/real party in interest
issues.why: Court must confirm Yanling is the proper party to seek relief for investment/profits.

issues.label: Reliance on living trust attempt
issues.why: Court must decide whether trust efforts affect claims, admissions, or remedies.

issues.label: Property titled solely in defendant
issues.why: Court must consider effect of title on ownership claims and equitable interests.

issues.label: Bona fide purchaser issues
issues.why: Sale of one property may implicate rights of third-party purchaser and remedy limitations.

issues.label: Necessary/indispensable parties
issues.why: Court must consider joinder of purchasers, lenders, or trust entities if relief affects title.

issues.label: Mortgage/lienholder interests
issues.why: Equitable relief may be limited by lenders’ rights and recorded liens.

issues.label: Damages proof burden
issues.why: Court must ensure plaintiff bears burden to prove damages with reasonable certainty.

issues.label: Speculation vs certainty
issues.why: Court must exclude speculative profits and define acceptable certainty for lost profits/proceeds.

issues.label: Rental income vs net income
issues.why: Court must decide whether split applies to gross rents or net after expenses.

issues.label: Tax and reporting implications
issues.why: Court must decide whether tax payments/withholdings are deductible or offset amounts owed.

issues.label: Agency/management authority
issues.why: Court must assess who controlled rentals and whether actions were authorized under venture.

issues.label: Defenses: failure of consideration
issues.why: Court must consider defenses that no enforceable exchange occurred or venture terms failed.

issues.label: Defenses: illegality/public policy
issues.why: Court must consider whether arrangement violates licensing, fraud, or other public policy bars.

issues.label: Defenses: waiver/estoppel
issues.why: Court must consider whether plaintiff’s conduct waived rights or estops claims.

issues.label: Defenses: laches
issues.why: Equitable claims may be barred by unreasonable delay causing prejudice.

issues.label: Defenses: unclean hands
issues.why: Equitable remedies may be limited if plaintiff acted inequitably.

issues.label: Defenses: accord and satisfaction
issues.why: Court must consider whether any later agreements resolved the dispute.

issues.label: Defenses: setoff/counterclaims
issues.why: Court must account for any offsets or counter-demands affecting recovery.

issues.label: Remedy election/duplicative recovery
issues.why: Court must prevent double recovery across contract, unjust enrichment, and conversion.

issues.label: Standard of review considerations
issues.why: If appealed, court must build record supporting discretionary sanctions and legal interpretations.
